meta.objective: Add an append-only `academy notes add/list` subcommand so agents can cheaply capture short-lived steering into notes.md.

in_scope: `academy notes add [<agent>] "text"` appends one Markdown bullet via appendFileSync (no full-file read)
`academy notes list [<agent>] [--last N]` prints the last N note bullets (default 12)
Agent resolution via explicit arg, then ACADEMY_AGENT_DIR / ACADEMY_AGENT_HOME / ACADEMY_AGENT_NAME env
Local-time timestamp format `- YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM: text`
Scaffold notes.md template instructs agents to use `academy notes add`
CLI regression tests + direct CLI validation
out_of_scope: Auto-deletion, expiry, graduation to other surfaces/skills

out_of_bounds: No auto-deletion, expiry, or pruning of old notes
No graduation/promotion to knowledge.md / role.md / identity.md / skills
No dedupe, ranking, search, or LLM summarization
No JSON or DB storage layer — Markdown file only
No file locking / concurrency coordination for appends
No reading the whole notes file on add

requirements_trace.description: `notes add "text"` appends a Markdown bullet without reading the whole file
`notes list` prints recent bullets, default last 12
Resolve agent via ACADEMY_AGENT_DIR/HOME/NAME when no explicit arg
Unresolvable agent fails with a short usage hint
Missing notes file for a valid agent is handled gracefully on list
Appended line uses local time `- YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM: text`
Default notes.md scaffold instructs agents to use `academy notes add`
CLI tests cover add/list/resolution/error paths; validated via real binary

where_this_fits: Single-file CLI `scripts/agent.mjs` (Node ESM, no deps), launched via `bin/academy`
Operates on the `notes.md` boot surface in each agent home under AGENTS_ROOT (~/.academy/agents/<name>)
technical_approach: Extend parseArgs switch (agent.mjs:58) and main() dispatch (agent.mjs:727) following existing command wiring
Reuse agentDir/validateName (agent.mjs:116,105) and the existing temp-AGENTS_ROOT spawn test pattern
Append with node:fs appendFileSync (new import) — never read+rewrite the file
key_decisions: Env var is ACADEMY_AGENT_DIR (what runAgent actually sets); accept ACADEMY_AGENT_HOME as spec-compat synonym
list treats only top-level `- `-prefixed lines as bullets; missing file => graceful empty
